facts.label: Cena e fato
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a cena e o passado simples para o fato: I was waiting when I dropped my bag.

facts.label: Cena
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a cena: I was waiting at the stop. He was reading a comic. Use was com I, he e she, e were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Fato
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o fato rápido: I dropped my bag. The driver stopped. Muitos verbos são irregulares: fell, took, sat, came. Combine com when.

pages.title: A bus stop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday morning at a bus stop in Vancouver. Light rain falls on the street. Luisa holds her bus ticket in one hand. Her classmate Tara comes with an umbrella. They wait for the school bus. Tara asks about yesterday.
“Hi, Luisa! Did you catch the bus yesterday?” says Tara. “Yes, but I was running when it came.” says Luisa. “Wow! What happened?” says Tara.
